items.headline: Samsara (IOT) shares jump after reporting Q1 FY27 revenue of ~$479M, 30%+ YoY growth, and third consecutive GAAP-profitable quarter with nearly $2B ARR
Samsara (IOT) stock up double digits as Q1 results beat expectations and company guides to continued revenue growth and ongoing GAAP profitability for FY27
Samsara (NYSE:IOT) beats Wall Street expectations with Q1 revenue up 30.5% YoY to $478.8M and strong ARR growth
